quote: We model the user‑news interactions as a bipartite graph and propose a novel Graph Neural News Recommendation Model with Unsupervised preference Disentanglement (GNUD).
We evaluate the performance of our model GNUD by comparing it with the following state‑of‑the‑art baseline methods.
All the baselines are initialized as the corresponding papers, and in terms of neural network models we use the same word embedding dimension for fair comparison.
Experimental results on real‑world news datasets demonstrate that our model achieves significant performance gains compared to state‑of‑the‑art methods.
